prompt: Listen to the complete audio without assuming its intended use. Describe what is actually audible, including event sequence, texture, attacks, resonance, movement, background or handling noise, and any obvious recording artifacts. Separate directly audible observations from uncertain guesses about the source. Do not invent speech, exact measurements, or calibrated quality scores. If no words are audible, do not transcribe. In at most 180 words, state what this recording would be suitable or unsuitable for as a quiet close-up sound effect. Do not assume filenames or metadata describe the sound.
scope: Noncommercial research auxiliary audio-model observation only. No human audition, no image/video or audiovisual synchronization judgment, no product acceptance, no private user content. Author filename and material label were withheld from model input.
retryPolicy: One inference only; stop on quota, login requirement, HTTP error or unknown outcome. No paid credits, no old token, no learning service.
